scope: bounded reference review for Machiya08 street/roof refit

sources.title: Freedom. — Japanese Yakitori Tavern #80
sources.status: primary page metadata verified; playback failed to load; public still visually inspected
sources.redistribution: not bundled; viewed for analysis only
observed: Ground floor has an opening with a low display/cooking counter visible from street
Entrance is beside the counter rather than a centered residential door between repeated small windows
Two eave levels; upper display behind a shallow rail; lamps attached near posts
Plain continuous side wall contrasts with detailed front; do not open every face indiscriminately
sources.limits: One public reposted still bearing Freedom watermark; no full video review or exact block recipe. Upper zone may be display/window rather than a walkable balcony.

sources.title: Freedom. — Store on the corner of the road #104
sources.status: new browser visual sampling of opening shots

samples.observed: Two storeys, wide main roof with visible edge strips, lower roof turns corner; upper frontage and planter/rail layers.

Entrance sits to one side of an open sales bay; purple hanging curtains do not seal the entire opening; display/rear backdrop visible between posts; red low furnishings and plants extend into the eave zone.

sources.limits: Opening shots only. No measured dimensions, no exact material/command recipe; no claim full viewing.

decisions.interpretation: Our facade repeats residential windows and closes the shop view. Reorganize by function and depth.
decisions.implementation: 4-wide low counter opening, 3-wide open recessed portal, distinct dining bay and short side service window

decisions.interpretation: Use rear glazing, thin outer lattice and locally planted sill rather than flat repeated wall panels.
decisions.implementation: narrow study bay, longer living group, supported ledge end pots; not a walkable balcony

decisions.interpretation: References support separate principal/secondary eaves and visible edge/soffit layers. Added smaller front gable is our design choice, not copied evidence.
decisions.implementation: one main ridge and one small transverse gable over eastern bay; varying hood depth, ridge caps/verges, gable timber/vents
